αἰδοίοισιν: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
αὐτίκ: αὐτίκα (elided αὐτίκ’) — at once, immediately, forthwith; adv.
αὐτοὶ: αὐτός — self; intensive pron., masc. nom. pl.: ’themselves’ · also intensive in agreement with an unexpressed ’we’: ’we ourselves’ (αὐτοὶ βῆμεν ’we ourselves stepped out’)
αὐτοῦ: αὐτός — self; masc. gen. sg., intensive with a possessive (ἑὸν αὐτοῦ ’his own very own’): ’of himself’ · also the fixed adv. αὐτοῦ, ’there, on the spot, right here’ · also plain gen. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’, governed by a preposition: ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ ’from him’ · also intensive with a noun, masc. gen. sg.: ’Alcinous himself’ (αὐτοῦ Ἀλκινόοιο)
αὐτόν: αὐτός — self; masc. acc. sg.: ’himself’, or reinforcing a pronoun of any person (με … καὶ αὐτόν ’me myself as well’) · also plain acc. sg. pronoun, unemphatic ’him’ as direct object of a verb: ἤλασε δ’ αὐτόν ’struck him’
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg.: ’himself’ · also masc. nom. sg. with a 1st-person subject: ’myself’ (ἐγὼν αὐτός) · also masc. nom. sg. with a 2nd-person subject: ’yourself’ (εἰδήσεις δὲ καὶ αὐτός ’you will see for yourself’)
αὖθ: αὖθι (elided αὖθ’) — here, on the spot, right here; adv. (distinct from αὖτε/αὖ ’again, in turn’)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
αὖτε: αὖτε — again, in turn, on the other hand; adv.
βαλὼν: βάλλω — throw, hit, strike; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg.: ’having struck, striking’
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γοῦνα: γόνυ — knee; neut. acc. pl., epic γοῦνα (= Attic γόνατα)
δέπας: δέπας — cup, drinking-cup; neut. nom./acc. sg.
δίκας: δίκη — custom, right, judgment; fem. acc. pl.: ‘judgments’, not yet the abstract ‘justice’
δείσαντες: δείδω — fear, dread; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having feared’
δμώων: δμώς — slave, bondman (esp. war-captive); masc. gen. pl.
δοίη: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 3 sg. (purpose): ’might give’
δοίης: δίδωμι — give; aor. opt. 2 sg.: ’you might give’
δυώδεκα: δώδεκα — twelve; indeclinable numeral, epic δυώδεκα (= Attic δώδεκα)
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῶκε: δίδωμι — give; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔδωκε)
εἰ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. · also introducing an indirect question after a verb of asking or telling: ’whether’ (εἰ δή ’whether indeed’) · also in εἰ δ’ ἄγε, an interjectional idiom with the imperative: ’come now, well then’
εἰλήλουθας: ἔρχομαι — come, go; redupl. perf. 2 sg., epic (= Attic ἐλήλυθας): ’you have come’
εἰμεν: εἰμί — be; pres. 1 pl., epic (= Attic ἐσμέν): ’we are’
εἰς: εἰς — into, to; prep. + acc. · also εἰμί ’be’: pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ): ’you are’ (τίς … εἰς; ’who are you?’) · also in the idiom εἰς ὅ (κε) ’until’: εἰς ὅ κεν … μιγήῃς ’until you mingle with’
εἴ: εἰ — if; conditional conj. (accented εἴ before a following enclitic, περ among them) · also introducing an indirect question, ‘whether’ (τίς δ’ οἶδ’ εἴ κέ ... ‘who knows whether’)
εἴη: εἰμί — be; pres. opt. 3 sg.: ’it might be, he might be’; impersonal + inf.: ’it might be possible for him’
εἴκοσ: εἴκοσι — twenty; indeclinable numeral, elided (εἴκοσ’ = εἴκοσι)
εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ · also attributive, agreeing with a neut. noun: ’wide’ (κλέος εὐρύ ’wide fame’)
εὐχόμεθ: εὔχομαι — declare oneself, avow; pres. 1 pl., elided (εὐχόμεθ’ = εὐχόμεθα)
ζεὺς: Ζεύς — Zeus, king of the gods; nom. sg.
θέμις: θέμις — custom, what is right, established usage; fem. nom. sg.
θεῖον: θεῖος — divine, god-inspired; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg., agreeing with a neuter noun (θεῖον ποτόν ’divine drink’)
θοὴν: θοός — swift, quick; fem. acc. sg.
θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg.
θυμὸς: θυμός — heart, spirit, desire; nom. sg.
θυμῷ: θυμός — heart, spirit, soul; dat. sg.
θύρῃσιν: θύρα — door; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι(ν) (= Attic θύραις)
κάτα: κατά — down, throughout; prep. + acc., placed after its noun with anastrophe: κραναὴν Ἰθάκην κάτα ’throughout rocky Ithaca’ · also standing after its verb, not after a noun: ἔχῃ κάτα δῆμον ἅπαντα ’holds throughout the whole land’ (κατά + acc., or tmesis for κατέχῃ)
κέλεαι: κέλομαι — bid, command, urge, exhort; pres. mid. 2 sg.
κέλευθα: κέλευθος — path, way, course; neut. nom./acc. pl. κέλευθα, epic by-form beside fem. sg. κέλευθος
κέρδιον: κερδίων — more profitable, better; neut. nom. sg., comparative of κέρδος
κακὸν: κακός — bad, evil; masc./neut. acc. sg.: ’by an evil (fate)’, inner acc. with μόρον · also neut. nom. sg., subject of an impersonal verb (τι … κακὸν … μελέτω ’let no evil thing be a care’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a plain substantive, direct object: ’harm, evil’ (κακὸν ἀλλοδαποῖσι φέροντες ’bringing harm to men of other lands’)
καρπαλίμως: καρπάλιμος — swift, nimble; adv. καρπαλίμως: ’swiftly, nimbly’
κατέθηκεν: κατατίθημι — put down, stow; aor. 3 sg. act. (ν-movable): ’put down, stowed’
κατεκλάσθη: κατακλάω — break down, shatter; aor. pass. 3 sg.: ’was broken down’ (of the heart)
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, in; prep. + acc.; also as preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἤσθιον = κατήσθιον ’devoured’) · also ’according to, in conformity with’ (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’) · also + acc., ’in quest of, after’ (κατὰ ληίδα ’in quest of plunder’) · also + gen., ’down from’ (κατὰ πετράων ’down from the rocks’)
κελόμην: κέλομαι — urge, bid, command; impf. 1 sg., unaugmented (= ἐκελόμην): ’I urged’
κλέος: κλέος — fame, renown, report; neut. nom. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. (same form), direct object: μέγα κλέος ἤρατο ’won great fame’; κλέος φέρειν ’bring report’
κρίνας: κρίνω — pick out, choose, judge; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having picked out’
κρητῆρα: κρητήρ — mixing-bowl (for wine and water); masc. acc. sg.
κρητῆρος: κρατήρ — mixing bowl; masc. gen. sg., epic κρητήρ (= Attic κρατήρ)
κωρύκῳ: κώρυκος — leather sack, bag; masc. dat. sg.
λαοὶ: λαός — people, host, men of the community; masc. nom. pl.
λαοὺς: λαός — people, folk, crowd; masc. acc. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς)
λαῖτμα: λαῖτμα — the gulf, the deep (of the sea); neut. nom./acc. sg.
ληιστῆρες: ληιστήρ — plunderer, pirate, freebooter; masc. nom. pl.
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλ: μάλα (elided μάλ’) — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγαν: μέγας — great, big, tall; masc. acc. sg.
μέγιστον: μέγας — great; superl. neut. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
μέλανος: μέλας — black, dark; masc./neut. gen. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ (the acute μέν is kept before a following enclitic; elsewhere μὲν) · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’ (οὐ μέν ’not indeed’)
μακάρων: μάκαρ — blessed, happy; masc. gen. pl., epithet of the gods
μαψιδίως: μαψιδίως — idly, heedlessly, to no purpose; adv.
μελιηδέα: μελιηδής — honey-sweet; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (adj. of two endings) · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masc. noun (μελιηδέα καρπόν ’honey-sweet fruit’)
μηκάδας: μηκάς — bleating; fem. acc. pl., of goats
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μυχὸν: μυχός — innermost part, recess; masc. acc. sg.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
μὴ: μή — not; negative particle in wishes, prohibitions, and purpose/fear clauses · also negating a conditional clause after εἰ: εἰ μὴ ’if not, unless’
μῆλα: μῆλον — sheep, goat, flock-animal; neut. nom. pl.: ’the flocks’ · also neut. acc. pl. (same form), direct object: ἦγον ... μῆλα ’they led sheep’
νήπιός: νήπιος — foolish, childish, witless; adj., masc. nom. sg., accented νήπιός before the enclitic εἰς
νηί: ναῦς (epic νηῦς) — ship; fem. dat. sg. νηί
νηλέι: νηλής — pitiless, ruthless; masc./neut. dat. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic νηλεῖ)
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
ξείνια: ξείνιος (Attic ξένιος) — of or for a guest; τὰ ξείνια as noun, gifts and entertainment due to a guest; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ξείνοισιν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν
ξείνων: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the strangers’
ξεινήιον: ξεινήιον — guest-gift; neut. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ξένιον)
ξεῖν: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend; voc. sg., elided (ξεῖν’ = ξεῖνε)
ξεῖνοι: ξεῖνος — stranger, guest-friend (epic = Attic ξένος); nom. pl.
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’) · also encl. dat. sg. fem. ’to/for her’ (ἥ οἱ ὁμηλικίη ’who was of an age with her’)
οἴη: οἶος — alone, only; fem. nom. sg.
οἴκαδε: οἶκος — house, home; + directional suffix -δε: ’homeward, to one’s home’
οἴνοιο: οἶνος — wine; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
οἷά: οἷος — of what kind, such as; relative/exclamatory adj., neut. nom./acc. pl., with τε in a comparison: ’just as, like’
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐδέ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj.
οὐδὲ: οὐδέ — and not, nor, not even; neg. conj. (grave, mid-clause form)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ · also the plain negative adverb in a declarative statement, with no question implied: ’not’
οὔθ: οὔτε (elided οὔθ’, before rough breathing) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὕνεκά: οὕνεκα — because, for the reason that (= οὗ ἕνεκα, contracted); conj.
οὕτω: οὕτω(ς) — thus, so, in this way; adv.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also masc. acc. sg.: ’all’ (πάντα δῆμον ’all the people’)
πίονα: πίων — fat, rich; neut. acc. pl., agreeing with νῶτα: ’fat’ · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with οἶκον: ’rich’
παιδὶ: παῖς — child, son; masc. dat. sg.
παρθέμενοι: παρατίθημι — set beside, put at risk, stake; aor. part. mid. masc. nom. pl.: ’having staked’
πλεῖθ: πλέω — sail; pres. 2 pl., elided and aspirated (πλεῖθ’ = πλεῖτε): ’do you sail?’
πολλούς: πολύς — much, many; masc. acc. pl.
πολὺ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’by far’ · also neut. nom. sg. adj. agreeing with ὕδωρ: ’much, plentiful’
προσέειπον: προσεῖπον (aor. of πρόσφημι) — speak to, address; aor. 1 sg.
πρῆξιν: πρῆξις (Attic πρᾶξις) — business, undertaking, transaction; fem. acc. sg., Ionic η
πόρεν: πόρω — give, grant, furnish (defective, aor. only); aor. 3 sg., unaugmented (= Attic ἔπορεν)
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv. · also a preposition + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ Νέστορα) · also preverb in tmesis (πὰρ … θῆκεν = παρέθηκε ’set before’) · also a preposition + dat., ’beside’ (πὰρ πυρί ’beside the fire’)
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σπέος: σπέος — cave, grotto; neut. nom./acc. sg. (an irregular neuter noun declined σπέος, σπείους, etc.)
σχεδόν: σχεδόν — near, close at hand; adv.
σὰ: σός — your (sg.); neut. acc. pl., agreeing with a neut. pl. noun: ’your (knees)’
σὺν: σύν — with, together with; prep. + dat. · also as adverb, ’together’, or as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb: σὺν … κάλυψε = συνεκάλυψε ’covered up’; σὺν … ἔπεσον = συνέπεσον ’fell together, clashed’
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τάλαντα: τάλαντον — talent (unit of weight of gold/silver); neut. acc. pl.
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, also marks a standing fact (epic τε) · also in the idiom ὅ τε (= ὅτι) ’in that, because’, giving a reason: ὅ τέ με … ἀποβῆναι ἀνώγει ’in that he bids me step off’
τίνες: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc. nom. pl., predicate of an infinitive · also predicate of a finite verb (εἰμί): τίνες ἐστέ; ’who are you?’ · also interrog. adj. + noun, masc. nom. pl.: ’what’ (τίνες κοῦροι)
ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τηλόθεν: τηλόθεν — from afar, from a distance; adv., ablatival suffix -θεν
τι: τις, τι — someone, something; neut. acc. sg., used adverbially with negatives ’at all’ · also adjectival indefinite: ’some, any’ (τι δήμιον ἄλλο ’some other public matter’) · also adverbial without a negative: ’in some way, in some measure’ (τι κατὰ πρῆξιν ’on some business’) · also as a substantive object, in a question: ’anything, something’ (ἦ ῥά τι ἴδμεν ’do we know anything’) · also the neut. of τις forming, with a preceding ὅ, the indefinite relative ὅ τι ’whatever, that which’ (αὔδα ὅ τι φρονέεις ’say whatever you have in mind’) · also ὅ τι as an adverbial acc. in an indirect question: ’why’
τις: τις, τι — someone, something, a certain one; indefinite pron., masc./fem. nom. sg.
τοί: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. pl. ’they’ · also relative: ’who’ · also encl. dat. sg. pron. σύ ’to you’ (= τοι, accented before a following enclitic, e.g. τοί τι)
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. pl. (ἀέθλους, τοὺς … ἐπειρήσαντο Ὀδυσῆος ’the contests with which they tried Odysseus’)
τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whose, of whom; masc. gen. sg. (τοῦ νῶι θεοῦ ὣς τερπόμεθ’ αὐδῇ ’whose voice we delight in’) · also demonstrative gen. of comparison after a comparative: τοῦ γε κρεῖσσον ’better than this’ · also neut. gen. sg. in ἐκ τοῦ: ’from that time’
τροίηθεν: Τροίη — Troy; adv. form with ablatival suffix -θεν: ‘from Troy’
τόν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg.: ’him’; also relative: ’whom’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τὰ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’these things’ · also in the adverbial idiom τὰ πρῶτα, ’at first, first’ (not ’these things’) · also with a noun, pointing to it: ’those, the’ (τὰ σὰ γούνατα ’those knees of yours’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’ · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ: whom, which; masc. acc. sg. (τὸν Ἀλφειὸς τέκε ’whom Alpheus begot’) · also demonstrative adjective with a noun: ’that, the’ (τὸν μῦθον ’that story, message’)
φέρε: φέρω — bring, carry; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἔφερε) · also pres. imper. 2 sg. (same form): φέρε χηλὸν ’bring the chest’
φέριστε: φέρτατος — best, bravest; vocative superl., masc. voc. sg.
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’used to bear’ · also ’carried, were carrying’ (φέρον ἐσθῆτα ’they carried the clothes’)
φέροντες: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
φέρτεροί: φέρτερος — stronger, better, superior; comparative adj. (no positive in use), masc. nom. pl., + gen. of comparison: ’stronger than’
φίλη: φίλος — dear, one’s own; fem. nom. sg. · also voc. sg. in address: ’dear one!’
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own (with kin/body parts serves as a possessive); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also masc. acc. sg., agreeing with a masculine noun: φίλον υἱόν ’dear son’ · also masc. acc. sg. predicative, agreeing with a pronoun: ’as a friend, welcome’ (φίλον ἐλθεῖν)
χεῦ: χέω — pour; aor. 3 sg., elided (χεῦ’ = χεῦε), idiomatic of heaping up a mound: ’heaped up’ (τύμβον χεῦε ’raised a tomb’) · also of sleep poured over the eyes, the standard onset-of-sleep formula: ὕπνον ἐπ’ ὄμμασι χεῦ’ ’poured sleep upon his eyes’
ψυχὰς: ψυχή — life, spirit, soul; fem. acc. pl.
ἀγήνωρ: ἀγήνωρ — lordly, manly, proud; adj. (2-termination), masc./fem. nom. sg.
ἀγλαὰ: ἀγλαός — splendid, shining, glorious; adj., neut. acc. pl. (ἀγλαὰ δῶρα ’splendid gifts’)
ἀείρας: ἀείρω — lift, raise (Attic αἴρω); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having lifted’
ἀλάλησθε: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; perf. 2 pl. with pres. sense: ’you wander’
ἀλέγουσιν: ἀλέγω — care for, heed (+ gen.); pres. 3 pl.
ἀλκήν: ἀλκή — defensive strength, valour; fem. acc. sg.
ἀλλοδαποῖσι: ἀλλοδαπός — of another land, foreign; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις), used substantively: ’to men of other lands’
ἀλόωνται: ἀλάομαι — wander, roam; pres. 3 pl. mid., diectasis, vowels stretched back out (= Attic ἀλῶνται)
ἀμείβετο: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented
ἀμειβόμενος: ἀμείβομαι — answer, reply; pres. part. masc. nom. sg. mid.
ἀμφιφορεῦσι: ἀμφιφορεύς — two-handled jar, amphora; masc. dat. pl.
ἀνέκαιε: ἀνακαίω — kindle, light up; impf. 3 sg., augmented after the preverb
ἀνέμοισιν: ἄνεμος — wind; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; prep. + acc. · also as preverb in tmesis (ἀνὰ … κέρασσεν, from ἀνακεράννυμι ’mix up’) · also + gen., ’up onto’ (ἀνὰ νηὸς ἔβην ’I went up on board’)
ἀπ: ἀπό (elided ἀπ’) — from, away from; prep. + gen.
ἀπώλεσε: ἀπόλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. 3 sg. act.
ἀπὸ: ἀπό — from, away from; + gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, separated from its verb (ἀπὸ … ὀλέσσει = ἀπολέσει ’will destroy’; ἀπὸ … δοθείη = ἀποδοθείη ’be given back’)
ἀρίστους: ἀγαθός — good; superlative ἄριστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’best’
ἀσκὸν: ἀσκός — skin, leather bag for liquids; masc. acc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδεω: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. gen. sg., epic -εω (= Attic -ου)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀφικόμεθ: ἀφικνέομαι — arrive, reach; aor. mid. 1 pl., elided (ἀφικόμεθ’ = ἀφικόμεθα): ‘we reached’
ἀχαιοὶ: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἁλμυρὸν: ἁλμυρός — briny, salty; adj., neut. acc. sg. (agreeing with ὕδωρ)
ἂν: ἄν — modal particle marking contingency (with subj. = future contingency, with opt. = potential) · also with a secondary indicative (impf./aor.) marking an unreal, contrary-to-fact conclusion: ’would’ (οὐκ ἂν ... ἀγόρευες ’you would not be speaking’) · also = ἀνά (preposition/preverb ’up’) in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἂν … βαῖνε = ἀνέβαινε, ἂν … βάντες = ἀναβάντες)
ἃ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; neut. acc. pl.: ’what things’ (ἃ μενοινᾷς ’what you desire’)
ἄγγεσιν: ἄγγος — vessel, jar, container; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι
ἄλλα: ἄλλος — other, another; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄλλως: ἄλλως — otherwise, in another way; adv.
ἄνδρ: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. sg., elided (ἄνδρ’ = ἄνδρα)
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, elided form ἄρ’ before a vowel · also the shortened form ἄρ used, without true elision, before τε in the fixed collocation ἄρ τε: τὰ μὲν ἄρ τε διεσκέδασ’
ἄχθος: ἄχθος — burden, load, weight; neut. acc. sg.
ἅλα: ἅλς — sea, salt sea; fem. acc. sg.
ἅμ: ἅμα (elided ἅμ’) — together with, at the same time as; adv./prep. + dat.
ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
ἐμπλήσας: ἐμπίμπλημι — fill (+ gen. of what fills); aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having filled’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’)
ἐπ: ἐπί (elided ἐπ’) — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐπ’ … χεῦε = ἐπέχευε ‘poured upon’)
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, over, towards, against; + dat./acc./gen. · also as adverb, no case expressed: ’to it, over it; besides’ (θεοὶ δ’ ἐπὶ μάρτυροι ’witnesses to it’; ἐπὶ κτέρεα κτερεΐξαι ’besides’) · also + dat., ’beyond, over and above, more than’ (ἐπὶ γαστέρι κύντερον ’more shameless than the belly’)
ἐρίηρας: ἐρίηρος — traditionally ’trusty’, exact sense uncertain (of companions); masc. acc. pl.
ἐρυθρόν: ἐρυθρός — red; neut. acc. sg. (νέκταρ ἐρυθρόν ’red nectar’)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐστέ: εἰμί — to be; pres. 2 pl.: ’you are’
ἐστίν: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg., ν-movable form
ἐσχατιῆς: ἐσχατιή — edge, border, remotest part; fem. gen. sg.
ἐυεργέα: ἐϋεργής — well-made, well-wrought; fem. acc. sg., uncontracted (= ἐϋεργῆ)
ἐφάμην: φημί — say, speak; impf. mid. 1 sg., epic uncontracted: ’I was speaking, I spoke’
ἐὺ: ἐΰ — well (Attic εὖ, printed without a diaeresis); adv.
ἑζόμενος: ἕζομαι — sit down, sit; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’sitting up’
ἑκάστῃ: ἕκαστος — each, every; fem. dat. sg.
ἑπτὰ: ἑπτά — seven; numeral, indecl. (ἑπτὰ καὶ δέκα ’seventeen’)
ἑτάροισι: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); dat. pl., epic -οισι
ἑτάρων: ἑταῖρος (epic ἕταρος) — companion, comrade; masc. gen. pl. (= Attic ἑταίρων)
ἑταίρους: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. acc. pl.
ἔθηκεν: τίθημι — put, place; aor. 3 sg., augmented: ’placed’
ἔκτοθεν: ἔκτοθεν — outside, away from (+ gen.); adv./prep.
ἔνδον: ἔνδον — within, inside, at home; adv. (distinct from the by-form ἔνδοθι, also ’within’)
ἔνθ: ἔνθα (elided ἔνθ’) — there, then; adverb of place or time
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic -εσι)
ἔργα: ἔργον — deed, work; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἔρυσθαι: ἔρυμαι — guard, protect, shelter; epic inf.
ἔσεσθαι: εἰμί — be; fut. inf.: ’to be, will be’
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold, keep to; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον)
ἕκαστα: ἕκαστος — each, every; neut. acc. pl. used substantivally: ’each thing, everything’
ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
ἠὲ: ἠέ — or; epic conj. (= Attic ἤ)
ἡδέος: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc./neut. gen. sg.
ἡδὺν: ἡδύς — sweet, pleasant; masc. acc. sg.
ἡμέας: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; acc. pl., epic ἡμέας (= Attic ἡμᾶς)
ἡμεῖς: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; nom. pl. ’we’
ἡμῖν: ἐγώ (pl. ἡμεῖς) — I, we; dat. pl. ’to us’
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj. (epic ἠέ/ἤ) · also ’than’ after a comparative: κρεῖσσον … ἢ ὅτε ’better than when’
ἤ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj., accented before an enclitic (ἤ κεν); ἤ … ἦε ’whether … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative: μεῖζον … ἤ ’greater than’
ἤθελε: ἐθέλω — wish, be willing, want; impf. 3 sg.
ἤλασε: ἐλαύνω — drive, strike; aor. 3 sg.: ’drove, struck’
ἤλθομεν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 pl.: ’we came’
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥμενοι: ἧμαι — sit; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἧος: ἧος — as long as, while; temporal conj., epic (= Attic ἕως) · also ’until’, and by extension ’so that’, introducing a purpose clause with the optative after a past main verb (ἧος … παύσειε ’so that it might stop her weeping’) · also plain temporal ’until’, with the indicative marking a definite past terminus: ἧος ... κατέπεφνεν ’until Artemis slew him’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱέμενοι: ἵεμαι — long for, strain toward, be eager; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’longing’ (οἴκαδε ἱέμενοι ’longing for home’)
ἱκόμεθ: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive; aor. mid. 1 pl., unaugmented, elided (ἱκόμεθ’ = ἱκόμεθα): ’we have come’
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense · also relative ’where’ + indic.: ἵνα … καθεύδετον ’where the two are sleeping’
ὀίσατο: ὀίομαι — think, suppose, imagine; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented
ὀδμὴ: ὀδμή — smell, scent, fragrance; fem. nom. sg.
ὀδώδει: ὄζω — smell (of), give off a smell; plpf. 3 sg. act. with impf. force: ’was wafting, smelled of’
ὀπηδεῖ: ὀπηδέω — accompany, attend (+ dat.); pres. 3 sg.: ’keeps company with’
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁδὸν: ὁδός — way, journey; fem. acc. sg.
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄις: ὄϊς — sheep; fem. acc. pl., epic ὄϊς (= Attic οἶς)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj. · also temporal ’until’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἵκετ’ Ἀρήτην ’until he came to Arete’) · also ’until’ + ἄν and subj. (ὄφρ’ ἂν ἵκηαι ’until you reach’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary verb: ’so that … might’ (ὄφρ’ … μένοιεν)
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’) · also + opt. in a purpose clause after a secondary-sequence verb: ὄφρα ... ἕλοις/ἵκοιο ’so that you might take/arrive’ · also temporal + indic., ’as long as’ (ὄφρα μὲν … ἦν ’so long as it was’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’) · also masc. nom. sg. pronoun ’he’ without γε, accented before an enclitic (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅν: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron. (indefinite with τε/τις: ὅν τινα = ὅστις, ’whatever’); masc. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τινά · also plain relative pron., masc. acc. sg., not accented for a following enclitic: ’whom’ (ὅν ῥα καθεῖσεν ’whom he had stationed’)
ὅπῃ: ὅπῃ — where, wherever, in whatever way; relative adv.
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also with τις, an indirect interrogative: οὐκ οἶδ’ ὅς τις ’I know not who’ · also with τις, indefinite relative: ὅς τις … φάγοι ’whoever should eat’
ὅσσ: ὅσος (epic ὅσσος, double σ) — as much/many as; neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅσσ’ = ὅσσα): ’as much as’ · also neut. nom. pl., subject of a verb: ὅσσ’ ἐπὶ γαῖαν ἑρπετὰ γίγνονται ’as many creatures as come to be upon earth’
ὅτε: ὅτε — when; temporal conjunction · also ’since, now that’ (ὅτε πρότερός γε πύθοιτο ’since he learned of it first’) · also with the optative, hypothetical/conditional: ’if ever, whenever’ (ὅτε ... ἵκοι ’if ever such need should come upon me’) · also with the subjunctive, general: ’whenever’ (ὅτε στείχῃσ’ ἀνὰ ἄστυ ’whenever she goes through the town’)
ὑγρὰ: ὑγρός — wet, fluid, liquid; neut. acc. pl.
ὑπ: ὑπό (elided ὑπ’) — under, beneath; prep. + gen.; also + acc., ’under, up under’ · also of agent with a verb of dying, ‘by, at the hands of’ + gen. (ὤλεθ’ ὑπ’ Αἰγίσθοιο ‘perished by Aegisthus’) · also + dat., ’under, beneath’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb, no case governed: οὓς ὑπ’ Ὀδυσσεὺς δύσετ’ = ὑπεδύσετο ’underneath which Odysseus sank down’
ὑπεὶρ: ὑπέρ — over, above; prep. + acc., epic lengthened by-form ὑπείρ
ὑπὲρ: ὑπέρ — over, beyond; + acc. (ὑπὲρ μόρον ’beyond one’s portion’) · also + gen., literally ’over, above’ (ὑπὲρ ἀργυρέοιο λέβητος ’over a silver basin’)
ὑψόσ: ὑψόσε — up on high, aloft; adv., elided ὑψόσ’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὕλης: ὕλη — wood, forest, thicket; fem. gen. sg.
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὥς: ὥς — thus, so; also (with κε/ἄν + subj.) ’so that, in order that’; adverb/conjunction · also introducing an indirect question: ’how’ (ὥς κε νέηται ’how he is to return’, after φράσσεται) · or ὡς ’as’, accented before enclitic τε · also causal, ’since, seeing that’ (ὥς οἱ ἐναργὲς ὄνειρον ἐπέσσυτο ’since a vivid dream had come upon her’) · also with κεν + opt., purpose: ’so that’ (ὥς κεν … γένοιτο ’so that he might become’)
ᾖα: ᾖα (contracted ἤια) — provisions for a journey; neut. nom./acc. pl. · also a different word, impf. 1 sg. of εἶμι ’go’: ’I was going’, unrelated to this noun
